name: Clara Resources Australia Ltd
summary: Aus Tin Mining Limited explores for nickel, gold, copper, and tin deposits in Australia. It holds interest in the Lachlan Fold Belt comprising three exploration licenses located within eastern Lachlan Fold Belt; Taronga Tin project located in Emmaville, New South Wales; and Queensland projects, which include the Kilkivan project located south west of Gympie, and MT cobalt and Pembroke projects, as well as holds an option to acquire Ashford Coking Coal project that consists of two granted exploration licenses located north of the Ashford township in northern New South Wales. The company was formerly known as AusNiCo Limited and changed its name to Aus Tin Mining Limited in November 2013. Aus Tin Mining Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.
